summary: Iteration 3 – Verified all 5 user-reported bug fixes. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass covering avatar endpoints (SVG fallback since fal wallet exhausted, as expected), /api/avatar/profiles listing 3 profiles pointing to /api/public/avatar/{gender}.jpg, real HTML crawl of vercel.com + stripe.com (no more Aurora Runner/NightHawk/Vortex Pro mock names, title contains site name, >=3 real items), chat/stream emits [[ACTION:escalate]] and [[ACTION:book:...]] markers, booking/confirm returns valid google_calendar_url. Frontend: demo login → dashboard OK, widget-escalate-btn and widget-book-btn confirmed REMOVED, widget-startcall-btn/widget-mic-btn/widget-send-btn/widget-avatar-image all present, startCall→endcall-btn transition works ('Voice call started'/'Voice call ended' messages appear), avatar image src correctly points to /api/public/avatar/female.jpg, Branding tab shows all 3 gender avatar tiles loading from backend. Zero console errors on /dashboard.
backend_tests_passed: GET /api/public/avatar/{male,female,neutral}.jpg → 200 image/svg+xml (dicebear fallback due to exhausted fal wallet - acceptable), body >500 bytes
GET /api/avatar/profiles → 200 with 3 profiles, each image URL ends with /api/public/avatar/{gender}.jpg
POST /api/knowledge/crawl url=https://vercel.com → title contains 'Vercel', >=3 items, no mock names
POST /api/knowledge/crawl url=https://stripe.com → title contains 'Stripe', no mock names
POST /api/chat/stream 'talk to a real human' → response contains [[ACTION:escalate]] marker
POST /api/chat/stream book intent → [[ACTION:book:...]] marker emitted (first or confirmation turn)
POST /api/booking/confirm → returns google_calendar_url starting with https://www.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE with text= and dates= params
GET /api/me/metrics → returns chats_today, bookings_week, voice_minutes, conversion_rate
frontend_tests_passed: widget-startcall-btn, widget-mic-btn, widget-send-btn, widget-avatar-image all present
click widget-startcall-btn → 'Voice call started' message + widget-endcall-btn appears
click widget-endcall-btn → 'Voice call ended' message + widget-startcall-btn reappears
Branding tab loads 3 gender tiles (male/female/neutral) from /api/public/avatar/
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 431 & 498 uses model 'gpt-5.6-terra' - non-standard model name; works via emergent proxy but confirm this is intentional (previously was 'gpt-4o-mini' etc).
server.py public_avatar has no fallback if _avatar_cache is empty (e.g. before startup finishes) - returns 404. Consider a stub SVG default.

Widget.jsx listenLoop() has no safeguard against runaway loop if SpeechRecognition instantly errors + onerror re-schedules listenLoop with 800ms delay – could cause tight failure loop on unsupported browsers. Consider max retries.

server.py chat_stream — Action markers instruction relies on LLM compliance; there's no server-side detection/normalisation. If model wraps marker in backticks or misspells, frontend won't intercept. Consider a regex-based post-processor server-side too.

server.py booking_confirm always books tomorrow 15:00 UTC regardless of the 'slot' string in request. The req.slot is only stored in details text – actual dates= param ignores parsed time. This is a functional issue: user requesting 'tomorrow 3pm' will get a calendar entry that doesn't parse their timezone or requested hour. Currently accepted as MVP but flag for future improvement.
